alert: FuseScope Collector dropping data on export

annotations.description: Dropped on export: send_failed or enqueue_failed appears for fusescope_clickhouse (and, by decision, fusescope_clickhouse/meter) (CUTOVER.md §4).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
(
  max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_spans{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_log_records{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
  or max by ("host.name", exporter) (increase(otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"}[10m]) > 0 or (otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} > 0 unless otelcol_exporter_enqueue_failed_metric_points{"service.name"="fusescope-collector", exporter=~"fusescope_clickhouse|fusescope_clickhouse/meter"} offset 10m))
)
